items.source: This class mainly serves as base class for BeanFactory implementations, factoring out the common management of singleton bean instances. Note that the ConfigurableBeanFactory interface extends the SingletonBeanRegistry interface.
items.translation: 该类主要作为 `BeanFactory` 实现的基类，提取了单例 Bean 实例的通用管理功能。请注意，`ConfigurableBeanFactory` 接口扩展了 `SingletonBeanRegistry` 接口。

items.source: Note that this class assumes neither a bean definition concept nor a specific creation process for bean instances, in contrast to AbstractBeanFactory and DefaultListableBeanFactory (which inherit from it). Can alternatively also be used as a nested helper to delegate to.
items.translation: 注意，该类既不假设存在 bean 定义概念，也不针对 bean 实例的创建过程有特定要求，这与 AbstractBeanFactory 和 DefaultListableBeanFactory（继承自该类）形成对比。此外，该类也可用作嵌套辅助类进行委托调用。

items.source: Also supports registration of DisposableBean instances, (which might or might not correspond to registered singletons), to be destroyed on shutdown of the registry. Dependencies between beans can be registered to enforce an appropriate shutdown order.
items.translation: 还支持注册 `DisposableBean` 实例（这些实例可能对应已注册的单例，也可能不对应），以便在注册表关闭时销毁它们。可以注册 bean 之间的依赖关系以强制实施适当的关闭顺序。

items.source: The main purpose of this method is to access manually registered singletons (see SingletonBeanRegistry.registerSingleton(String, Object)). Can also be used to access a singleton defined by a bean definition that already been created, in a raw fashion.
items.translation: 此方法的主要目的是访问手动注册的单例（参见 SingletonBeanRegistry.registerSingleton(String, Object)）。也可用于以原始方式访问已通过 bean 定义创建的单例。

items.source: The default implementation preserves any given exception in this registry's collection of suppressed exceptions, up to a limit of 100 exceptions, adding them as related causes to an eventual top-level BeanCreationException.
items.translation: 默认实现会将此注册表中给定的任何异常保留在受抑制异常集合中，最多限制为 100 个异常，并将它们作为相关原因添加到最终的顶级BeanCreationException。

items.source: The main purpose of this method is to check manually registered singletons (see SingletonBeanRegistry.registerSingleton(String, Object)). Can also be used to check whether a singleton defined by a bean definition has already been created.
items.translation: 此方法的主要目的是检查手动注册的单例（参见 SingletonBeanRegistry.registerSingleton(String, Object)）。也可用于检查由 Bean 定义定义的单例是否已经创建。

items.source: The main purpose of this method is to check manually registered singletons (see SingletonBeanRegistry.registerSingleton(String, Object)). Can also be used to check which singletons defined by a bean definition have already been created.
items.translation: 此方法的主要目的是检查手动注册的单例（参见 SingletonBeanRegistry.registerSingleton(String, Object)）。也可用于检查由 Bean 定义定义的哪些单例已经创建。

items.source: The main purpose of this method is to check manually registered singletons (see SingletonBeanRegistry.registerSingleton(String, Object)). Can also be used to count the number of singletons defined by a bean definition that have already been created.
items.translation: 此方法的主要目的是检查手动注册的单例（参见 SingletonBeanRegistry.registerSingleton(String, Object)）。也可用于统计由 Bean 定义定义的、且已创建的单例数量。

items.source:
To be called for early exposure purposes, for example, to be able to
resolve circular references.
items.translation: 用于早期暴露，例如，以解决循环引用。

items.source:
Checks already instantiated singletons and also allows for an early
reference to a currently created singleton (resolving a circular reference).
items.translation: 检查已实例化的单例，并允许对当前正在创建的单例进行早期引用（解决循环引用）。

items.source: The default implementation register the singleton as currently in creation.
items.translation: 默认实现将单例注册为当前正在创建的状态。

items.source: The default implementation marks the singleton as not in creation anymore.
items.translation: 默认实现会将单例标记为不再处于创建状态。

items.source:
Disposable beans usually correspond to registered singletons,
matching the bean name but potentially being a different instance
(for example, a DisposableBean adapter for a singleton that does not
naturally implement Spring's DisposableBean interface).
items.translation: 可丢弃的 Bean 通常对应于注册的单例，其名称与单例匹配，但可能是不同的实例（例如，为未自然实现 Spring 的 `DisposableBean` 接口的单例提供的 `DisposableBean` 适配器）。

items.source:
Also registers the containing bean as dependent on the contained bean
in terms of destruction order.
items.translation: 同时也注册包含的 Bean，使其在销毁顺序上依赖于被包含的 Bean。

items.source:
Add a callback to be triggered when the specified singleton becomes available
in the bean registry.
items.translation: 向 Bean 注册表添加一个回调，以便在指定的单例可用时触发。

items.source: Clear all cached singleton instances in this registry.
items.translation: 清除此注册表中所有缓存的单例实例。

items.source: Destroy the given bean.
items.translation: 销毁给定的 Bean。

items.source: Return the names of all beans that the specified bean depends on, if any.
items.translation: 返回指定 Bean 所依赖的所有 Bean 的名称（如果有）。

items.source: Return the names of all beans which depend on the specified bean, if any.
items.translation: 返回所有依赖于指定 Bean 的 Bean 的名称（如果有）。

items.source: Return the (raw) singleton object registered under the given name.
items.translation: 返回在给定名称下注册的原始单例对象。

items.source:
Return the (raw) singleton object registered under the given name,
creating and registering a new one if none registered yet.
items.translation: 返回在给定名称下注册的（原始）单例对象，如果尚未注册则创建并注册一个新的。

items.source: Determine whether a dependent bean has been registered for the given name.
items.translation: 确定是否已为给定名称注册了依赖 Bean。

items.source:
Determine whether the specified dependent bean has been registered as
dependent on the given bean or on any of its transitive dependencies.
items.translation: 确定指定的依赖 Bean 是否已注册为给定 Bean 或其任何传递性依赖的依赖项。

items.source:
Return whether the specified singleton bean is currently in creation
(within the entire factory).
items.translation: 返回指定的单例 Bean 是否当前正在创建中（在整个工厂内）。

items.source:
Register a dependent bean for the given bean,
to be destroyed before the given bean is destroyed.
items.translation: 为给定的 Bean 注册一个依赖的 Bean，以便在给定 Bean 销毁之前进行销毁。

items.source:
Remove the bean with the given name from the singleton registry, either on
regular destruction or on cleanup after early exposure when creation failed.
items.translation: 从单例注册表中移除给定名称的 Bean，无论是在常规销毁时，还是在早期暴露后创建失败进行清理时。

items.source:
Destroy the given bean. Must destroy beans that depend on the given
bean before the bean itself. Should not throw any exceptions.
items.translation: 销毁给定的 Bean。在销毁该 Bean 本身之前，必须先销毁依赖于给定 Bean 的 Bean。不应抛出任何异常。

items.source: By default, all threads are forced to hold a full lock through null. DefaultListableBeanFactory overrides this to specifically handle its threads during the pre-instantiation phase: true for the main thread, false for managed background threads, and configuration-dependent behavior for unmanaged threads.
items.translation: 默认情况下，所有线程都通过 `null` 被强制持有完整锁。`DefaultListableBeanFactory` 对此进行了覆盖，以专门处理其预实例化阶段的线程：主线程为 `true`，托管后台线程为 `false`，未托管线程的行为则取决于配置。

items.source: To check whether a bean factory contains a bean definition with a given name, use ListableBeanFactory's containsBeanDefinition. Calling both containsBeanDefinition and containsSingleton answers whether a specific bean factory contains a local bean instance with the given name.
items.translation: 要检查 Bean 工厂是否包含具有给定名称的 Bean 定义，请使用 `ListableBeanFactory` 的 `containsBeanDefinition`。同时调用 `containsBeanDefinition` 和 `containsSingleton` 可以回答特定的 Bean 工厂是否包含具有给定名称的本地 Bean 实例。

items.source: The given instance is supposed to be fully initialized; the registry will not perform any initialization callbacks (in particular, it won't call InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet method). The given instance will not receive any destruction callbacks (like DisposableBean's destroy method) either.
items.translation: 给定的实例应已完全初始化；注册表将不会执行任何初始化回调（特别是，它不会调用 InitializingBean 的afterPropertiesSet方法）。给定的实例也不会接收任何销毁回调（例如 DisposableBean 的destroy方法）。

items.source: When running within a full BeanFactory: Register a bean definition instead of an existing instance if your bean is supposed to receive initialization and/or destruction callbacks.
items.translation: 在完整的 BeanFactory 中运行时：如果您的 Bean 需要接收初始化和/或销毁回调，请注册 Bean 定义而不是现有实例。

items.source: NOTE: This lookup method is not aware of FactoryBean prefixes or aliases. You need to resolve the canonical bean name first before obtaining the singleton instance.
items.translation: 注意：此查找方法不了解 FactoryBean 前缀或别名。在获取单例实例之前，您必须先解析规范化的 Bean 名称。

items.source: Only checks already instantiated singletons; does not return true for singleton bean definitions which have not been instantiated yet.
items.translation: 仅检查已实例化的单例；对于尚未实例化的单例 Bean 定义，不会返回 `true`。

items.source: Use BeanFactory's containsBean for general checks whether the factory knows about a bean with a given name (whether manually registered singleton instance or created by bean definition), also checking ancestor factories.
items.translation: 使用 `BeanFactory` 的 `containsBean` 进行通用检查，以确定工厂是否知道具有给定名称的 Bean（无论是手动注册的单例实例还是由 Bean 定义创建的），同时也检查祖先工厂。

items.source: NOTE: This lookup method is not aware of FactoryBean prefixes or aliases. You need to resolve the canonical bean name first before checking the singleton status.
items.translation: 注意：此查找方法不了解 FactoryBean 前缀或别名。 在检查单例状态之前，您需要先解析规范化的 Bean 名称。

items.source:
Typically invoked during registry configuration, but can also be used
for runtime registration of singletons. As a consequence, a registry
implementation should synchronize singleton access; it will have to do
this anyway if it supports a BeanFactory's lazy initialization of singletons.
items.translation: 通常在注册表配置期间调用，但也可用于单例的运行时注册。因此，注册表实现应同步对单例的访问；如果它支持 BeanFactory 的单例延迟初始化，无论如何都必须执行此操作。

items.source: To be called for exposure of freshly registered/created singletons.
items.translation: 用于调用新注册或创建的单例对象的暴露。

items.source:
Only checks already instantiated singletons; does not return an Object
for singleton bean definitions which have not been instantiated yet.
items.translation: 仅检查已实例化的单例；对于尚未实例化的单例 Bean 定义，不会返回一个 Object。

items.source:
Only checks already instantiated singletons; does not return names
for singleton bean definitions which have not been instantiated yet.
items.translation: 仅检查已实例化的单例；不会返回尚未实例化的单例 Bean 定义的名称。

items.source:
Only checks already instantiated singletons; does not count
singleton bean definitions which have not been instantiated yet.
items.translation: 仅检查已实例化的单例；不会统计尚未被实例化的单例 Bean 定义。

items.translation: 销毁给定的 Bean。如果找到对应的可丢弃 Bean 实例，则委托给destroyBean。

items.translation: 将给定的单例对象添加到单例注册表中。

items.source:
Add the given singleton factory for building the specified singleton
if necessary.
items.translation: 如有必要，添加用于构建指定单例的给定单例工厂。

items.translation: 单例创建后的回调。

items.source: Callback before singleton creation.
items.translation: 在创建单例之前调用的回调。

items.source: Check if this registry contains a singleton instance with the given name.
items.translation: 检查此注册表是否包含具有给定名称的单例实例。

items.source: Return the number of singleton beans registered in this registry.
items.translation: 返回此注册表中注册的单例 Bean 的数量。

items.source: Return the names of singleton beans registered in this registry.
items.translation: 返回在此注册表中注册的单例 Bean 的名称。

items.source: Determine whether the current thread is allowed to hold the singleton lock.
items.translation: 确定当前线程是否允许持有单例锁。

items.source:
Register an exception that happened to get suppressed during the creation of a
singleton bean instance, for example, a temporary circular reference resolution problem.
items.translation: 注册在创建单例 Bean 实例期间被抑制的异常，例如临时循环引用解析问题。

items.source:
Register a containment relationship between two beans,
for example, between an inner bean and its containing outer bean.
items.translation: 在两个 Bean 之间注册包含关系，例如在内层 Bean 与其包含的外层 Bean 之间。

items.source: Add the given bean to the list of disposable beans in this registry.
items.translation: 将此 Bean 添加到该注册表的可处置 Bean 列表中。

items.source:
Register the given existing object as singleton in the bean registry,
under the given bean name.
items.translation: 将给定的现有对象注册为单例，在指定的 Bean 名称下。

items.source: Return the singleton mutex used by this registry (for external collaborators).
items.translation: 返回此注册表使用的单例互斥锁（供外部协作方使用）。

items.source: true if the current thread is explicitly allowed to hold the lock but also accepts lenient fallback behavior, false if it is explicitly not allowed to hold the lock and therefore forced to use lenient fallback behavior, or null if there is no specific indication (traditional behavior: forced to always hold a full lock)
items.translation: 如果当前线程被明确允许持有锁但也接受宽松的回退行为，则为true；如果被明确禁止持有锁并因此被迫使用宽松的回退行为，则为false；如果没有具体指示（传统行为：始终被迫持有完整锁），则为null。
